# SafeProxy

[Git Source](https://github.com/robotmoney/robotmoney-core/blob/aae683920cd57dc96d920c3e2d788e226f098aef/contracts/test/vendor/safe-1.4.1/proxies/SafeProxy.sol)

**Title:** SafeProxy - Generic proxy contract allows to execute all transactions applying the code of a master contract.

**Authors:** Stefan George - &lt;stefan@gnosis.io>, Richard Meissner - &lt;richard@gnosis.io>

## State Variables

### singleton

```solidity
address internal singleton;
```

## Functions

<a id="constructor-address"></a>

### constructor

Constructor function sets address of singleton contract.

```solidity
constructor(address _singleton);
```

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| _singleton | `address` | Singleton address. |

<a id="fallback"></a>

### fallback

<i>

Fallback function forwards all transactions and returns all received return data.

</i>

```solidity
fallback() external payable;
```
